Recipe:
Oatmeal Peanut Butter Blocks 18 From the Kitchen of Mrs. Boat Head Lunch Lady at Ransom's Elementary School
§ion;
When Ransom was in Cherry Hill Elementary School in Orem, Utah, the head cook was an immigrant named Mrs. Boat. (Her name was pronounced "Boot".) This recipe is for one of the favorite treats that she made.
Butter ½ Cup1 Stick
White Sugar½ Cup Brown Sugar½ Cup Baking Soda½ teaspoon Salt1 teaspoon Vanilla½ teaspoon Egg1
Peanut Butter ¼ Cup½ Stick
Flour1 Cup Quick Oats1 Cup
Chocolate Chips½ 12-oz. Package Powdered Sugar½ Cup
Peanut Butter ¼ Cup½ Stick
Cream2-3 Tablespoons
In a large mixing bowl, Cream together Butter, White Sugar and Brown Sugar. Blend in Baking Soda, Salt, Vanilla, Egg and Peanut Butter. Stir in Flour and Oats. Press dough evenly into a 9&inch; &by; 13&inch; pan. Bake at 350° for 20 minutes. Remove from oven and immediately sprinkle with Chocolate Chips. Let stand for 5 minutes, then, using a spatula, spread the soft Chocolate Chips evenly across the top. Mix Frosting ingredients together, then spread evenly across the top. Let cool, then cut into rectangles ≈2&inch; &by; 3&inch;.
Letting the Chocolate Chips sit for 5 minutes on the hot cookie makes them soften. It is pretty cool to see Chocolate Chips, then start spreading and see Chocolate.
